description:
- Responsible for industrial automation and electronic control systems, with a primary focus on non-sewing machinery.
- Perform component-level troubleshooting, diagnosis, and repair of PCB assemblies and electronic control boards used in sewing and non-sewing machines.
- Diagnose machine faults through electrical measurements, circuit analysis, and systematic troubleshooting of electronic components.
- Support machine reliability through technical problem-solving, preventive improvement, and control system maintenance.
- Currently involved in the development of an Automatic Strap Folding Machine integrated with Bartack operations.
